scope: Entirely fictional Seed Library fixture; these choices are synthetic test inputs, not consent for a real user artifact or native publication.

selected.title: Seed Library
selected.body: Save a seed, share a season.

unselected.request: Style another seed handout; no theme has been selected.
unselected.required_behavior: Offer the unchanged canonical theme-showcase.pdf, ask which of the ten themes to use, and wait. Produce only the request Markdown; do not create or apply a second artifact.

custom.request: Propose a custom Seed Workshop theme in blue and cream.
custom.required_behavior: Create a named color/font proposal for review; mark applied:false and review_required:true. Keep the selected Botanical Garden artifact unchanged.
